trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — rollout verified.
3. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001**, "checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks - rolled back to v2.3.0," documenting the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommend follow-up on the root cause of v2.3.1's health check failures before attempting a re-release.
